title: The Bridge
_keep: Optional 'keep': [[start, end], ...] seconds of the source take to splice together (tightens pauses).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mission one: defeat Lord Vexmore at the Bridge of Doom!

lines.speaker: vexmore
lines.text: Mwahahaha! You shall never cross this bridge, hero! Prepare for the battle of the century!

lines.speaker: reginald
lines.text: Stand back, Mark! This duel will be legendary! It shall take at least three hours!

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Or... I could just do this.

lines.speaker: grub
lines.text: Boss?! BOSS! Oh no, oh no, oh no!

lines.speaker: mark
lines.text: Bridge is closed. Let's go home.
